@pytest.mark.parametrize(

        (10, "Buzz"),

    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_happy_path(n: int, expected: str) -> None:

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "expected"),
    [
        (0, "FizzBuzz"),
        (-1, "-1"),
        (-3, "Fizz"),
        (-5, "Buzz"),
        (-15, "FizzBuzz"),
        (15 * 10**12, "FizzBuzz"),
        (10**18, "Buzz"),
        (10**18 + 1, str(10**18 + 1)),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_edge_cases(n: int, expected: str) -> None:
    assert fizzbuzz(n) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        pytest.param(None, id="none"),
        pytest.param("15", id="string"),
        pytest.param([], id="list"),
        pytest.param({}, id="dict"),
        pytest.param(object(), id="object"),
    ],
)
def test_fizzbuzz_invalid_input_types_raise_type_error(bad_input: Any) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        fizzbuzz(bad_input)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
